name: Naked POC Magnet
note: A real volume-at-price profile is built for each regular-hours session: bins bin_pct percent of the session open wide, every bar's volume spread evenly over the bins its [low, high] covers, and the POC is the midpoint of the fullest bin. A finished session's POC joins a list and stays on it only while it remains NAKED - the moment any later session's range contains that price it is struck off, so membership is a topological fact about the tape rather than a threshold. Between start_min and end_min ET the nearest naked POC above and below the last price are measured in units of the SESSION ATR(14) built from the same profiles; the setup trades toward whichever is nearer, provided it sits between min_atr and max_atr away - close enough to be reachable, far enough to be worth the trip. One trade per level per day. Exit is the level itself, or flat at flat_min ET. The 1.0 x session-ATR stop the idea specifies is carried as st_atr in BAR-ATR units, which is the only stop unit the shared harness has.
source: Market Profile / volume profile lineage (Steidlmayer, CBOT Liquidity Data Bank). Definitions and the naked/virgin POC concept per LuxAlgo concept library, https://www.luxalgo.com/library/concept/naked-poc/ and https://www.luxalgo.com/library/concept/point-of-control/ ; profile construction per TradingView docs, https://www.tradingview.com/support/solutions/43000502040-volume-profile-indicators-basic-concepts/ . Exact bin widths, ATR gating and the 60-session horizon are the harvesting agent's specification.

import math


def _clock(ctx):
    """ET minute-of-day, session-day index and an RTH flag, from timestamps.

    The feed carries extended hours and some symbols have no premarket at all,
    so nothing here counts bars to find a session -- it all comes off the
    clock. US DST boundaries are calendar arithmetic, not a peek at the tape.
    """
    import datetime as _dt
    etm = []
    day = []
    rth = []
    cache = {}
    last = None
    di = -1
    for b in ctx.bars:
        ts = b["t"]
        y = int(ts[0:4]); mo = int(ts[5:7]); dd = int(ts[8:10])
        hh = int(ts[11:13]); mi = int(ts[14:16])
        g = cache.get(y)
        if g is None:
            g = (1 + ((6 - _dt.date(y, 3, 1).weekday()) % 7) + 7,
                 1 + ((6 - _dt.date(y, 11, 1).weekday()) % 7))
            cache[y] = g
        dst = (mo > 3 or (mo == 3 and dd >= g[0])) and \
              (mo < 11 or (mo == 11 and dd < g[1]))
        tot = hh * 60 + mi - (240 if dst else 300)
        key = (y, mo, dd)
        if tot < 0:
            tot += 1440
            pv = _dt.date(y, mo, dd) - _dt.timedelta(days=1)
            key = (pv.year, pv.month, pv.day)
        if key != last:
            last = key
            di += 1
        etm.append(tot)
        day.append(di)
        rth.append(570 <= tot < 960)
    ctx.f_etm = etm
    ctx.f_day = day
    ctx.f_rth = rth


def family_init(ctx):
    _clock(ctx)
    b = ctx.bars
    n = len(b)
    binp = max(0.005, float(ctx.p.bin_pct)) / 100.0

    # ---- per-session RTH profile, POC, and session OHLC ----
    sess = []            # (day index, open, high, low, close, poc)
    cur = None
    prof = {}
    for i in range(n):
        if not ctx.f_rth[i]:
            continue
        d = ctx.f_day[i]
        o = float(b[i]["o"]); hi = float(b[i]["h"])
        lo = float(b[i]["l"]); cl = float(b[i]["c"])
        vl = float(b[i].get("v") or 0.0)
        if cur is None or cur[0] != d:
            if cur is not None:
                sess.append(_finish(cur, prof))
            cur = [d, o, hi, lo, cl, max(1e-9, o * binp)]
            prof = {}
        else:
            if hi > cur[2]:
                cur[2] = hi
            if lo < cur[3]:
                cur[3] = lo
            cur[4] = cl
        w = cur[5]
        a = int(math.floor(lo / w))
        z = int(math.floor(hi / w))
        if z < a:
            z = a
        if z - a > 400:
            z = a + 400
        share = vl / float(z - a + 1)
        for k in range(a, z + 1):
            prof[k] = prof.get(k, 0.0) + share
    if cur is not None:
        sess.append(_finish(cur, prof))

    # ---- session ATR(14), Wilder, usable from the session AFTER it forms ----
    an = max(2, int(ctx.p.atr_sess))
    atr = [None] * len(sess)
    tr = []
    for s in range(len(sess)):
        h, l, c = sess[s][2], sess[s][3], sess[s][4]
        if s == 0:
            tr.append(h - l)
        else:
            pc = sess[s - 1][4]
            tr.append(max(h - l, abs(h - pc), abs(l - pc)))
        if s + 1 == an:
            atr[s] = sum(tr) / an
        elif s + 1 > an:
            atr[s] = (atr[s - 1] * (an - 1) + tr[s]) / an
    by_day = {}
    for s in range(len(sess)):
        by_day[sess[s][0]] = s

    # ---- walk the tape: keep the naked list, emit signals ----
    look = max(3, int(ctx.p.look_sess))
    smin = int(ctx.p.start_min)
    emax = int(ctx.p.end_min)
    lo_a = float(ctx.p.min_atr)
    hi_a = float(ctx.p.max_atr)
    sig = [0] * n
    tgt = [None] * n
    naked = []          # list of (session index, price)
    used = set()
    curday = None
    si = None
    for i in range(n):
        if not ctx.f_rth[i]:
            continue
        d = ctx.f_day[i]
        if d != curday:
            curday = d
            si = by_day.get(d)
            if si is not None and si >= 1:
                naked.append((si - 1, sess[si - 1][6]))
            if si is not None:
                naked = [x for x in naked if si - x[0] <= look]
            used = set()
        if si is None:
            continue
        lo = float(b[i]["l"]); hi = float(b[i]["h"]); c = float(b[i]["c"])
        # a level this bar traded through is not naked any more
        naked = [x for x in naked if not (lo <= x[1] <= hi)]
        t = ctx.f_etm[i]
        if t < smin or t > emax:
            continue
        av = atr[si - 1] if si >= 1 else None
        if av is None or av <= 0.0:
            continue
        U = None
        D = None
        for (_s, pxl) in naked:
            if pxl > c and (U is None or pxl < U):
                U = pxl
            elif pxl < c and (D is None or pxl > D):
                D = pxl
        dU = (U - c) / av if U is not None else None
        dD = (c - D) / av if D is not None else None
        if dU is not None and lo_a <= dU <= hi_a and (dD is None or dU < dD):
            if (U, d) not in used:
                used.add((U, d))
                sig[i] = 1
                tgt[i] = U
        elif dD is not None and lo_a <= dD <= hi_a and (dU is None or dD < dU):
            if (D, d) not in used:
                used.add((D, d))
                sig[i] = -1
                tgt[i] = D
    ctx.f_sig = sig
    ctx.f_tgt = tgt


def _finish(cur, prof):
    """Close a session: POC is the midpoint of the fullest volume bin."""
    w = cur[5]
    best = None
    bv = -1.0
    for k, v in prof.items():
        if v > bv:
            bv = v
            best = k
    poc = (best + 0.5) * w if best is not None else (cur[2] + cur[3]) / 2.0
    return (cur[0], cur[1], cur[2], cur[3], cur[4], w, poc)


def signal(ctx, i):
    return ctx.f_sig[i]


def exit_signal(ctx, i):
    if not ctx.positions:
        return False
    if ctx.f_etm[i] >= int(ctx.p.flat_min) or not ctx.f_rth[i]:
        return True
    e = min(p["entry_i"] for p in ctx.positions)
    if i <= e:
        return False
    d = 1 if ctx.positions[0]["side"] == "long" else -1
    t = ctx.f_tgt[e - 1] if e >= 1 else None
    if t is None:
        return False
    if d > 0:
        return ctx.h[i] >= t
    return ctx.l[i] <= t
